_spec.law: Facts resolve to the original verified claim record. A layout rebuild does not reverify reporting.

dek.text: ERCOT says some large loads have finished every process except approval to energize. Batch Zero classifications still depend on verification and model requirements.

introduction.text: Finishing a grid study is not permission to switch on. ERCOT identified {{number:c12}} large loads that had completed every process except approval to energize. Their combined peak demand over the stated period was {{number:c12:1}} megawatts.

The [Batch Zero verification process](c1) creates another distinction. A conditional classification is a place in the process subject to requirements, not an unconditional promise of capacity or an operating authorization.

paragraphs.text: ERCOT requires information and documents through the transmission service provider, with notarized attestations from participating parties. A load may be removed if its entity fails to provide what the provider needs to respond on time.

The required evidence varies with the project's classification and the respondent's role. Conditional inclusion can also depend on correcting dynamic-model deficiencies or receiving a commission exception. Verification is not the only remaining condition.

sections.heading: Company disclosures add detail, not certainty

paragraphs.text: [Galaxy's disclosure](c26) identifies its projects and their conditional classifications. It says Caspian was submitted as base load but classified as studied load. The company also discloses the risk that a project could be removed.

ERCOT's public classification notice names no individual load and gives no capacity total. The company account supplies project-specific information that the public market notice itself does not verify by name.

The relevant next records are completion of applicable conditions and explicit approval to energize. A queue label, a completed study and an operating approval describe different stages. This edition does not collapse them into a single cleared status.
